capabilities: collect links with future dates into a right-panel view
track upcoming tasks in one place
reuse the Daily notes date template
problem: Obsidian has no built-in place to see all future-dated links scattered across notes in a single view.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses "Daily notes" plugin to grab dates template.

summary: Right-panel view that collects all links with future dates from the vault into one list for tracking upcoming tasks.
